warp-masque: &warp-masque
  type: masque
  sni: sni.example
  private-key: cGFzc3dvcmQ=
  public-key: cGFzc3dvcmQ=
  ip: 172.16.0.2
  ipv6: 2001:db8::3

proxies:
- name: "[WARP-AWG] Default"
  <<: *warp-common
  server: 203.0.113.40
  port: 4500
- name: "[WARP-MASQUE] QUIC"
  <<: *warp-masque
  server: 203.0.113.40
  port: 443
- name: "[WARP-MASQUE] H2"
  <<: *warp-masque
  server: 203.0.113.40
  port: 443
  network: h2

proxy-groups:
- name: Cloudflare
  type: select
  icon: https://icon.example/cloudflare.svg
  proxies:
    - "[WARP-AWG] Default"
    - "[WARP-MASQUE] QUIC"
    - "[WARP-MASQUE] H2"
  url: 'http://speed.cloudflare.com/'
  interval: 300

rules:
